title: fix(agents): preserve worktree-local ignored state during lossless cleanup

nodes.body:
One remaining lossless gap: this needs to compare the provisioned file's metadata/type, not only its bytes.

`copyIncludedFiles()` treats mode as part of the restorable state: it `lstat`s the source, accepts only a regular non-symlink, copies it, and then applies `sourceStat.mode` (`src/agents/worktrees/service.ts:198-208`). The new guard instead uses `readFile()` on both sides (`:239-246`). On POSIX, changing only the managed copy's mode (for example source `0644`, worktree `0755`) leaves `git status --porcelain` clean and the bytes equal, so `removeIfLossless()`/GC still removes the worktree. Restore then reprovisions the source's `0644` mode, losing the worktree-local executable bit. Replacing the managed copy with a symlink whose target has the same bytes is also missed because `readFile()` follows it, while restore recreates a regular file.

Please `lstat` both paths and treat a type/symlink or relevant permission-bit difference as unrestorable, with a regression test that chmods the provisioned worktree copy while leaving the source mode unchanged and expects `removeIfLossless()` to return `false`. The content comparison and its placement in both run-end and GC paths otherwise look like the right owner-boundary fix; exact-head CI is green.

Retain or derive the provisioned-file set independently of the source manifest’s current contents, compare that set with the exact state restore can recreate, and cover manifest removal and pattern changes with real-service regressions.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

Yes. The PR supplies a concrete real-service reproduction where only an ignored provisioned file changes, tracked status remains clean, baseline removal destroys the new value, and the patched head preserves it.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

No, not yet. The comparison belongs at the cleanup owner boundary, but using only the source checkout’s current include manifest leaves the lossless guarantee incomplete when provisioning rules change after worktree creation.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Preserve files after the source include manifest changes — `src/agents/worktrees/service.ts:216-218`
  This guard derives the protected set only from `repoRoot/.worktreeinclude` at cleanup time. If a file was provisioned, its worktree copy diverges, and the source removes the pattern or manifest, this returns false or skips the path; cleanup can delete the worktree while neither snapshot nor restore retains the unique value. Preserve the effective provisioned set independently of the current source manifest and add regressions for manifest and pattern removal.
